How to Apply a BAK Theme
On first use, select only MIUI/backup/AllBackup. If Xiaomi’s picker refuses the folder, use the All Files Access option on the home screen.
Open the backup with Select BAK File. Enable the translation option if desired; the app uses Advanced API translation when configured, otherwise free on-device translation.
Tap Prepare & Open Restore. With translation enabled, the button reads Translate, Prepare & Open Restore. The app creates a new date-and-time backup folder.
In Backup & Restore, switch to Restore. Select the newest date-and-time folder, choose Themes, and tap Restore.

In Xiaomi Themes, open Profile/Account > My themes, select the restored theme, and tap Apply. If full application is rejected, use Customize Theme to apply Lock screen, Icons, and System UI separately.
